origin.description: Coerce a value with as.character. A crayon style becomes its opening ANSI sequence.

arguments.text: Further arguments, ignored for a style.

origin.details: For a style function this is start(x). For anything else it is as.character.

translation.description: Coerce a value with as.character. A crayon style becomes its opening ANSI sequence.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A style, a str, a number, or a list.

translation.details: A style returns start(x). Numbers use their decimal spelling, and a whole number has no decimal point. A list comes back as a list of strings.
translation.value: A string, or a list of strings.
